disclaimer: All sources are open or student-accessible data used to TRAIN and demonstrate the forecasting method. They are proxies and do not reflect the true state of the Malaysian labour market; that would need far higher-quality (licensed) data. Model quality is judged by how accurately it forecasts from the data it is given, not by how trustworthy the data is.

tiers.2: Curated media or policy coverage. Leading but noisy.
